counting_rules.human_approvals: Strict human actions (e.g. named approvals in review notes/PRs); strictly distinct from tool execution consent or harness prompts.
counting_rules.tool_consents: Tracked separately as platform/tool confirmation prompts; never counted as human approvals.
counting_rules.elapsed_time: Monotonic wall-clock seconds from benchmark checkpoint start to completion; human wait time recorded separately.
counting_rules.token_accounting: Categorized SHA-256 delivered inputs separated into catalog, router, skill bodies, and other. Incomplete or unverified accounting remains null (unavailable), never zero.
